title: Had Codex make me a teaser for the 3rd person open world shooter I'm tinkering with.
author: luciddream00

comments.author: luciddream00
comments.body:
Always loved the flying and hovering combat in Anthem, despite hating the overall structure of that game, so I'm mashing it together with Earth Defense Force and Tron. Maybe a dash of GTA for some systemic open world shenanigans. 

Humanoid model is a store asset, song is "The Fault Lines" by David O'Dowda, the rest was made with Codex, Blender and Unity.
